notes.title: Weekly Devlog #13 - 11/22/2022
notes.content:
Hey there, folks!

First off, we’re excited to announce that Silverblood is officially a registered trademark of Tidehead Studios LLC! The trademarking process has been a little over a year in the making, and it honestly feels a bit surreal! 

[b]Art & Design[/b]
[list]
[*] The art assets for our new demo are almost complete, barring a few additional sprite variants for Edith and Colette!
[*] As a small note: character emote animations won’t be making it into the first iteration of the demo, but they are still planned for the full release.
[/list]

[b]Narrative[/b]
[list]
[*] More editing passes are waiting pending the prologue’s full implementation into the engine. 
[*] This also includes sensitivity reader(s) and QA!
[/list]

[b]Technical[/b]
[list]
[*] We had a very productive meeting this week!
[*] We identified some fixes to the current build, and have confirmed that we’re still well on track for the December release of the new demo!
[/list]

[b]Promotional Content[/b]
[list]
[*] Released a new installment of Carraway’s Travelogue! Carraway has a curious visitor… Where has she seen them before?
[*] Released another lore post!
[/list]

[b]Con+Alt+Del[/b]
[list]
[*] Ordered prints to sell at our booth in Artist’s Alley!
[*] Our artist Vextera will be taking live commissions at our booth–stop by for some on-the-spot art!
[/list]

Implementation is currently the name of the game, folks. Things are coming together, and we can’t wait to show you!

See ya next week!

notes.title: Weekly Devlog #8 - 10/18/2022
notes.content:
Hello all! After a well-deserved period of rest, the dev team is back in action. But we haven’t been completely absent over the last few weeks!

[b]Admin & Workflow[/b]
[list]
[*] Refined and added to our narrative building tools.
[/list]

[b]Art & Design[/b]
[list]
[*] Started working on some more backgrounds and sprites!
[*] Began preparing some promotional illustrations… What could they be for? :O
[/list]

[b]Narrative[/b]
[list]
[*] Continued the restructuring process and refined some overall aspects of story content.
[*] Completed some light editing on the prologue and chapter 1.
[/list]

[b]Technical[/b]
[list]
[*] Made adjustments to the cutscene system for a smoother gameplay experience during scene types which utilize that game mode. (There are multiple!)
[*] Constructed the camera animations for the final scene in the prologue. 
[/list]

[b]Promotional Content[/b]
[list]
[*] Released a few installments of Carraway’s Travelogue, complete with one of our new banners!
[*] Released a few installments of our Silverblood universe lore post!
[*] Began prepping in earnest for Con+Alt+Del in December!
[/list]

Three cheers to getting back in the saddle! See you next week!

notes.title: Devlog Week #2
notes.content:
[u][b]Weekly Devlog 
8/16/2022
[/b][/u]
Hey, all! Vextera here with Tidehead Studios’ weekly devlog!

We made a lot of progress this week, especially in the art department! Here’s what happened this week:

[b]Admin & Workflow[/b]
[list]
[*] Began looking into options for prints and stickers for Con+Alt+Delete in December, which we’ll be attending to promote Silverblood!
[*] Established a new weekly feature for Patreon: [b]Carraway’s Travelogue![/b]
[*] Updated the Tidehead Studios website and gave Silverblood its own section.
[*] Began working on the Characters section on the website.
[*] Began constructing a Carraway’s Travelogue section on the website.
[/list]

[b]Art & Design[/b]
[list]
[*] Finished an environment for the very first scene (a cinematic!) in the [b]brand new prologue[/b]!
[*] …On that note, started storyboarding the first cinematic in the prologue!
[*] Started a new environment for Whiterock Village, a location featured in the new prologue!
[*] Continued work on the UI, which includes drafts of the menus and a layout for choices and an animation!
[*] Drafted sketches for new sprites of Edith’s fellow acolytes. (They’re getting speaking roles and need to face the camera!)
[*] Started drafting a cinematic for the Ritual in Chapter 1.
[/list]

[b]Narrative[/b]
[list]
[*] Began restructuring Chapter 1 based on adjustments made by adding the new prologue.
[*] Drafted two specific scenes for Chapter 1.
[*] Completely revised the Ritual that Edith and the girls must complete to hear their prophecies from the Grandmatron.
[/list]

[b]Promotional Content[/b]
[list]
[*] Posted our first [b]Carraway’s Travelogue[/b], a weekly short story documenting a writer’s adventures in the Silverblood universe!
[*] Finished a character illustration of Carraway.
[*] Reached out to an artist to assist with additional visual content for Carraway’s Travelogue.
[/list]

…And a few other things that we’ll be keeping secret for now. ;)

See you all next week!
